commit.subject: LU-18687 build: move kernel checks to python3
commit.message:
LU-18687 build: move kernel checks to python3

We can build a lot faster as well as move the compat checking
directly into the kernel following a precedent, for example,
    drivers/tty/vt/gen_ucs_fallback_table.py

Adds python3 dependency, however it available on all targets,
in most cases installed by default.

Test-Parameters: trivial
Signed-off-by: Shaun Tancheff <shaun.tancheff@hpe.com>
Change-Id: I45465e69c3ae3d5f0cc81742bd2a6f333cf407cf
